title: Design Mode comment store
description: Why comments are persisted instead of clipboard-based.
body: Design Mode used to end at the clipboard: pick an element, copy Markdown and a picture, paste both into an agent. That works in a chat window nowhere else — an agent in a terminal cannot be pasted an image. This is the store that replaces it. A comment is a request against one captured element with an id that outlives the app, a status saying whose turn it is, and a thread both sides take turns in.
